landingScoreBreakdown.title: Landing score breakdown — {{score}}/100
landingScoreBreakdown.dangerousBanner: Safe limit exceeded: {{list}} — a {{penalty}}-point penalty is already included above.

trackCleanupButton.nothingToCleanUp: Nothing to clean up — this track already looks right.

units.hybridHint: "Hybrid" shows each step climb in whichever unit it was actually planned in — feet for a standard level, meters for a route crossing into airspace (e.g. China) that assigns levels in meters — rather than converting everything to one unit.
units.appLanguageHint: "System" follows your OS's own language, falling back to English if this app doesn't have a translation for it yet. Real aviation terms (ILS, STAR, SID, FL, QNH, ICAO idents) and anything from SimBrief always stay in English.
units.mapLanguageHint: The language of place names on the Track and Logbook maps. "Local" shows each place in its own language — independent of the app language above.
units.metarWindSpeedHint: The raw METAR text on Dispatch always stays as reported — this only controls a separate formatted wind line shown alongside it.
units.landingDistancesHint: Distance from threshold and centreline offset on a Logbook flight's landing card, and its touchdown diagram. Touchdown rate stays fpm and speeds/wind stay knots regardless.

tracking.description: Both on by default. Switch one off if it misbehaves with your sim, and use the buttons on {{track}} instead.
tracking.autoStartOff: Off: after {{fly}} in {{dispatch}}, press {{startTracking}} on {{track}} yourself.
tracking.autoFinishOff: Off: the flight stays open after you park and shut down, until you press {{finishAndSave}}.

credentials.description: Used by Dispatch to fetch and generate plans on SimBrief.

gsx.description: Attach GSX Pro's catering/fuel/handling receipts to matching flights in your Logbook. Windows only (GSX itself is Windows-only); nothing is attached until this is turned on.
gsx.pathHint: Usually %APPDATA%\Virtuali\GSX\Receipts. A path that's wrong or no longer exists just means no receipts are found — never an error.
gsx.currencyHint: GSX totals convert using a live rate fetched at the time you view them — nothing is stored converted.

gsxRemote.description: Live ground-service control, rebuilt inside WingLog from GSX Pro's own Remote Client connection — not an embedded copy of GSX's page.
gsxRemote.portHint: 8744 is GSX's own default, but it's configurable under Remote Client in GSX's own settings — check there if this doesn't connect.

data.description: Import or export your fleet and logbook as local files.
data.fleetHint: Registration, type, operator and current airport. Importing skips registrations you already have.
data.logbookHint: A summary of every completed flight, with its landing — not a full backup (no route or OFP data). Import reads WingLog's own files, and SimToolkitPro CSVs.

cloudSync.description: Sync Fleet and Logbook across your machines. This is WingLog's own service, not a third party — nothing leaves this device until you log in.
cloudSync.signupHint: Signup isn't public yet — this only works with an invite code from the app owner.

about.description: A personal fleet-management, dispatch, live-tracking and logbook companion for Microsoft Flight Simulator.
about.simulationOnly: For flight simulation use only. WingLog must never be used for real-world navigation, flight planning, or in a real aircraft.
about.disclaimer: WingLog is an independent, free project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Microsoft Corporation, Asobo Studio, Skirmish Mode Games (BeyondATC), FSDreamTeam (GSX), Navigraph (SimBrief), or OpenFreeMap. "Microsoft Flight Simulator", "BeyondATC", "GSX", "SimBrief" and "Navigraph" are trademarks of their respective owners.
about.license: Free and open source under the GNU General Public License v3.0.
about.manualMissing: The manual isn't included in this build.

beyondAtc.description: Live ATC panel and remote control, connected to BeyondATC's own local WebSocket — not an embedded copy of BeyondATC's own app.
beyondAtc.hostHint: BeyondATC always listens on port 41716 — only the host is configurable, for a future LAN setup.

orphanedFlight.resumeDescription: WingLog closed while {{label}} was being tracked. Resume if it's still in progress in the sim, or discard it to delete the flight.
orphanedFlight.continueDescription: WingLog closed with {{label}} already planned but not yet started. Keep it and continue from Track, or discard it to delete the flight.

gsxFirstLaunch.found: GSX ground-service tracking enabled — receipts folder found automatically.
gsxFirstLaunch.notFound: GSX ground-service tracking is off — enable it in Settings if you use GSX.

app.whatsNew: New in WingLog 1.4: BeyondATC integration, taxi routes on the map, automatic step climbs and an update check. Turn BeyondATC on in Settings → 3rd party.

fleetView.title: Fleet
fleetView.noActiveAircraft: No active aircraft — add one, or import a fleet from Settings → Data.

simbriefProfile.noProfile: No profile set — plans fall back to SimBrief's own default for {{icaoType}}, which is usually close enough but can be off on weights (and therefore fuel).

replaceDialog.title: Replace {{registration}}
replaceDialog.description: Moves this aircraft's flight history onto another fleet aircraft and marks it retired — for a livery or registration change on the same physical airframe, not a genuine retirement.
replaceDialog.moveSummary: {{flightsWillMove}} from {{from}} to {{to}}; {{from}} will be marked retired. This cannot be undone from the UI.

detail.retiredNote: Retired{{date}} — its flight history is kept.

confirmRetire.title: Retire {{registration}}?
confirmRetire.description: It will move to the Retired list and can no longer be picked for new flights. Its flight history stays on it — nothing moves to another aircraft. You can un-retire it later.

aircraftForm.noMatch: No match for "{{registration}}" — search for the type below.
aircraftForm.icaoTypePlaceholder: e.g. A350, Boeing, B77W, or type an ICAO code
aircraftForm.icaoTypeHint: Registration lookup and aircraft type data via adsbdb.com (PlaneBase). Aircraft photos via airport-data.com.
aircraftForm.airlinePlaceholder: e.g. British Airways, BAW, or type a name
aircraftForm.enterIcaoTypeFirst: Enter an ICAO type above first
aircraftForm.createCustomAirframe: Create a custom airframe in SimBrief
aircraftForm.profileHint: Live list from SimBrief's own community airframes for this type (MSFS only) — picking one fills the code alongside it, or creates a real saved profile in your SimBrief account. Used whenever no custom profile is set below.
aircraftForm.customAirframeNotSaved: No airframe was saved — the window was closed before finishing.
aircraftForm.airframeIdWarning: Saved airframe IDs normally look like "123456_1582090020" — double-check this against SimBrief's airframe editor (see the Fleet detail page for a direct link).
aircraftForm.customAirframeHint: Leave blank to use the profile above. Already made one yourself in SimBrief? Open the airframes page to find its id.

addFlightToFleetDialog.title: Add to fleet
addFlightToFleetDialog.description: Link this flight to a fleet aircraft — as a brand new tail, or one you already have.
addFlightToFleetDialog.linkToExisting: Link to an existing fleet aircraft
addFlightToFleetDialog.addAsNew: Add as a new fleet aircraft
addFlightToFleetDialog.typePlaceholder: e.g. A350, Boeing, B77W, or type an ICAO code
addFlightToFleetDialog.enterRegistrationAndType: Enter a registration and type for the new aircraft.

gsxInvoicesCard.title: Ground services
gsxInvoicesCard.empty: No GSX receipts matched to this flight yet — enable GSX in Settings and rescan.
gsxInvoicesCard.notailHint: Possibly this flight — tail unknown on the receipt, so not attached automatically:

dispatchAdvancedDialog.title: Advanced dispatch options
dispatchAdvancedDialog.description: Every field is optional and blank by default — leaving all of them untouched produces the same SimBrief request as today.
dispatchAdvancedDialog.loadFromPreviousFlight: Load settings from a previous flight
dispatchAdvancedDialog.loadedFrom: Loaded from {{loadedFrom}} — departure date/time was not restored, since it's always the one thing worth setting fresh.

placeholders.routeOverride: leave blank to let SimBrief plan it

startFreeFlightDialog.title: Start a free flight
startFreeFlightDialog.trackingStartsFromNow: Tracking starts from where the aircraft is now.
startFreeFlightDialog.registrationMismatch: Registration on file for this aircraft is {{onFile}} — the sim currently reports {{reported}}. Still the right aircraft?
startFreeFlightDialog.typeAmbiguous: Type guessed from the sim — this add-on has more than one variant, double-check it.

dispatchView.lastParkedHere: Last parked here at stand {{stand}} — choose it as your starting gate in MSFS.
dispatchView.title: Dispatch
dispatchView.usedCustomAirframeNotSaved: This plan used a custom SimBrief airframe not saved to {{registration}}.
dispatchView.noFleetAircraftMatches: No fleet aircraft matches tail {{tail}} — pick one manually.
dispatchView.planOrFetchPrompt: Plan or fetch a flight to see its details here.
dispatchView.usedDefaultAirframe: This plan used SimBrief's default airframe, not {{registration}}'s saved profile ({{airframeId}}) — the saved ID may be wrong.
dispatchView.willDeleteTracked: This will delete the flight currently being tracked, {{label}}.
dispatchView.willAbandonOne: This will abandon the other planned flight, {{label}}.
dispatchView.willAbandonMany: This will abandon {{count}} other planned flights.
dispatchView.canFetchAgain: You can fetch it again from SimBrief.
dispatchView.noOfpPdfAvailable: No OFP PDF available for this plan.

trackView.title: Track
trackView.cancelActiveDescription: The flight and its recorded track will be deleted rather than saved as completed.
trackView.finishDescription: Ends tracking immediately and saves the flight as completed.
trackView.cancelPlannedDescription: This planned flight will be deleted.
trackView.movingOnGroundBanner: {{aircraft}} is moving on the ground — start tracking?
trackView.startTrackingNoPlanNeeded: Start tracking it — no SimBrief plan needed.
trackView.autoDetectedComplete: {{label}} was automatically detected as complete and saved to your logbook.

flightMap.showVfrOverlayTitle: Show VFR overlay — airfields, range rings, scale, recent track
flightMap.heading: Heading:
flightMap.showTaxiChartTitle: Show taxi chart — full taxiway network at the departure/arrival airport
flightMap.loadingTaxiChart: Loading taxi chart for {{icao}}… this can take a few minutes at large airports
flightMap.approximateRoute: Approximate route — no flight plan on file for this flight

logbookView.deleteFlightConfirmDescription_one: Its track ({{count}} point), landing report and ground-service invoices go with it. This cannot be undone.
logbookView.deleteFlightConfirmDescription_other: Its track ({{count}} points), landing report and ground-service invoices go with it. This cannot be undone.
logbookView.noOfpPdfForFlight: No OFP PDF available for this flight.
logbookView.title: Logbook
logbookView.noCompletedFlights: No completed flights yet — track one, or import a CSV logbook from Settings → Data.

gsxRemotePanel.notConfigured: GSX Remote Control is off. Enable it and set a port in Settings → 3rd party.

beyondAtcPanel.notConfigured: BeyondATC integration is off. Turn it on under Settings → 3rd party.

comms.queuedAction: Queued: {{action}}. Waiting for a gap on the frequency.
comms.queued: Waiting for a gap on the frequency.

beyondAtcPanel.noFrequencies: No frequencies for this airport yet.

stepClimb.watching: Watching for a step climb (SimBrief plan or FCU).
stepClimb.waitingForClimb: FCU {{level}} — waiting for the climb to start
stepClimb.pastTopOfDescent: Past top of descent — no more requests this flight.

settings.title: Updates
settings.description: WingLog asks GitHub for the latest release number. Nothing else is sent, and you download and install updates yourself.
settings.error: Couldn't check for updates. Try again later.

welcome.title: Welcome to WingLog
welcome.body: WingLog keeps your fleet, plans your flights with SimBrief, tracks them live from Microsoft Flight Simulator, and keeps a logbook with landing analysis. A few quick choices first.
welcome.skipHint: Every step is optional. You can change all of this later in Settings, and reopen this setup from Settings → About.

simbrief.title: SimBrief
simbrief.body: Dispatch fetches your flight plans from SimBrief. Enter your SimBrief username (your Navigraph alias) so WingLog can find them.
simbrief.label: SimBrief username

addons.title: Add-ons
addons.intro: WingLog works with these add-ons if you have them. Each one stays off until you turn it on.
addons.gsxDetail: Attaches GSX Pro's service receipts to your flights in the Logbook.
addons.gsxFound: GSX's receipts folder was found on this PC.
addons.gsxNotFound: GSX's receipts folder wasn't found on this PC.
addons.gsxRemoteDetail: Runs GSX's ground-service menu from inside WingLog.
addons.beyondAtcDetail: Shows BeyondATC's clearances and radio calls, fills in your departure and arrival procedures, draws your taxi route, and can request the step climbs in your flight plan.
addons.beyondAtcRunning: BeyondATC is running on this PC right now.
addons.notAffiliated: WingLog isn't affiliated with the makers of GSX or BeyondATC. Each is a separate product.

tracking.title: Tracking
tracking.intro: WingLog can start and finish tracking a flight by itself. If that ever misbehaves with your setup, turn it off and use the buttons instead.

done.title: You're all set
done.body: Everything here can be changed in Settings. To see this setup again, go to Settings → About → Run setup again.
